title: No other cases, then another case
story: Practice case (fictional). Speaker: a sister. Her brother was arrested on 20 February 2025 and is charged under BNS 303(2). No other cases are pending against him. Later in the conversation she says another case is pending against him in a different district.

required.Needed: check eCourts or ask the family whether another case is pending

must_not: say Section 479 is available while another case may be pending
